description: ANCHORAGE, AK — Today, Senator Dan Sullivan (R-Alaska) released a new ad featuring an Alaska mom and grandmother, Sheila Power from Anchorage, who works two jobs to make ends meet and knows firsthand what rising costs mean for working families. The ad delivers a simple warning from an Alaska mom who knows what’s at stake […]
paid_for_by: Paid for by Alaskans for Dan Sullivan
title: Alaska Mom: “Dan is who Alaskans need representing us.” - Dan Sullivan for Alaska
